correctness.rationale: Exact cumulant factorization and true variance checked. The dimensionless F is the Beta(1,2) MGF of the second-size-biased jump law. A Stieltjes/Laplace endpoint lemma gives F~K exp(s)/s^(beta+2) and s F'/F=s-(beta+2)+o(1). Lower and upper variational comparisons locate every global maximizer at s/L->1; stationarity gives H=s-(beta+3)+o(1) and b/c=s+1+o(1), yielding both claimed constants. Endpoints, beta>0 and nonuniqueness limits are explicit. Standalone 262 finite assertions passed; the analytic proof establishes the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The minimal true-variance right sub-gamma scale is a motivated concentration invariant. A whole continuum of finite endpoint-tail exponents beta>0 has identical first-order 1/log dilution but distinct sharp (beta+3)loglog terms and an explicit constant. The result quantitatively distinguishes uniform and triangular continuous jump laws, strengthens a purely qualitative Gaussian smoothing comparison, and provides all-global-maximizer asymptotics without unjustified uniqueness.
